conversation_pain_points: bot did not simplify language when asked

main_topics.reason: The user asked whether anything could help, then repeatedly asked how to access treatment and engaged with discussion of medication and exercise.
The user directly asked whether they would feel this way forever and returned to wanting a clear answer about what to expect.
The user described longstanding pain throughout the body and later named several areas that hurt most in the mornings.
The user described feeling tired despite sleeping nine hours and asked whether it could be part of fibromyalgia or something else.
The user said their doctor gave the diagnosis without offering treatment and asked how to pursue options.
The user repeatedly said the explanations and terminology were confusing, including that they felt more confused than when they started.

output.summary: The user wanted to know whether fibromyalgia can be treated and whether the pain would last forever, and also asked about morning pain and fatigue. The assistant repeatedly used technical terms and medication lists after requests for simpler language; the user said they were more confused than when they started and ended the conversation to rest.
